_about: The Audio EQ tool's predefined templates (Editing Guide p.743-744; docs/spec/audio-eq.md).
The guide names them only in a picture (p.744) and gives no values: it sends the reader to the Console of a seat.
Each entry says where its values come from in 'source': 'observed' (seen in Media Composer itself, by
black-box observation), 'documented' (a guide's words), or 'guess' (from the name alone). Replace a guess
when better information turns up, and say where it came from in 'note'. Order is the Fast menu's.
Gains are dB (+15 to -20). Turnovers and centres are Hz, and may be any value from 20 to 20000 Hz.
'midOctaves' is the midrange's width in octaves (1/16 to 4). The tool shows these values but does not

templates.name: Female Voice with Presence
templates.note: Low rumble cut; presence lift around 4 kHz, above a male voice's; a little air.

templates.name: Male Voice with Presence
templates.note: Rumble cut below the voice's fundamental; presence lift around 3 kHz.

templates.name: Music High Boost with Mid-Rollout
templates.note: As Music High Boost, with a wide cut in the midrange.

templates.name: Music Low Boost with Mid-Rollout
templates.note: As Music Low Boost, with a wide cut in the midrange.

templates.name: NTSC Hum Buster
templates.note: 'Cuts the bass on frequencies that often cause hum on NTSC systems' (p.743): a narrow cut at 60 Hz mains hum and a low shelf cut.

templates.name: PAL Hum Buster
templates.note: As NTSC Hum Buster, at 50 Hz mains hum.

templates.name: Tape Hiss Filter
templates.note: 'Tape Hiss Filter rolls off frequencies above 4 kHz' (p.743). The amount is a guess.

templates.name: Tape Hiss Filter with High-End Boost
templates.note: A wide cut where hiss is loudest, with the very top lifted back.

templates.name: Telephone EQ "A"
templates.note: Approximate values read from the Audio EQ tool in a public video of Media Composer (owner's report, 2026).

templates.name: Telephone EQ "B"
templates.note: A narrower telephone band than "A": the classic 300-3400 Hz voice channel.
